premise: Bird builds a nest one twig at a time; Squirrel brings moss, Woodpecker taps the tree to test it, and it holds.
inspiration: The Three Little Pigs' building motif, turned: nobody builds alone and nobody blows it down; friends help make one house strong.
lesson: A home is built with friends' help.
learning: Birds build nests from twigs, grass and moss

en-US.title: Bird Builds a Nest
en-US.text: {bird:enter} Bird flew in and landed on a branch of the big tree. {bird:face happy} [curious] Spring was coming, and he needed a nest. {bird:hop} He {bird:go to meadow} fetched a twig. Then another, and another, {bird:go back} woven round and round. Then a tuft of soft, dry grass. Along bounded {squirrel:enter} Squirrel. {squirrel:face surprised} Is that a nest? she asked. It needs something soft! {squirrel:hop x2} She brought a pawful of green moss to line it. {squirrel:face happy} [happily] Snug! {woodpecker:enter} Woodpecker flew over and clung to the trunk. {bird:face sad} But is the tree strong enough? [whispers] Everyone waited. {woodpecker:live} Woodpecker tapped the bark, {sfx:tap} tap-tap-tap, pressed his eye close and listened… tapped once more, and chirped. {woodpecker:face happy} {bird:face happy} Strong as can be! {bird:live} Bird puffed up his chest, tipped his head back and {sfx:song} sang his happiest song, then fluttered his wings. {squirrel:hearts} {canvas:night 0.6 16s} [softly] That night, he tucked himself into his nest, round and warm, {bird:face sleeping} and dreamed of his friends.

es-ES.title: Pájaro hace un nido
es-ES.text: {bird:enter} Pájaro llegó volando y se posó en una rama del árbol grande. {bird:face happy} [curious] Venía la primavera, y necesitaba un nido. {bird:hop} {bird:go to meadow} Trajo una ramita. Y otra, y otra más, {bird:go back} tejidas en redondo. Luego un mechón de hierba suave y seca. Llegó dando brincos {squirrel:enter} Ardilla. {squirrel:face surprised} ¿Eso es un nido?, preguntó. ¡Le falta algo blandito! {squirrel:hop x2} Trajo un puñado de musgo verde para forrarlo. {squirrel:face happy} [happily] ¡Qué calentito! El {woodpecker:enter} pájaro carpintero llegó volando y se agarró al tronco. {bird:face sad} Pero ¿será fuerte el árbol? [whispers] Todos esperaron. {woodpecker:live} El carpintero dio golpecitos en la corteza, {sfx:tap} toc-toc-toc, pegó el ojo para escuchar… dio otro golpecito, y pió. {woodpecker:face happy} {bird:face happy} ¡Fortísimo! {bird:live} Pájaro infló el pecho, echó la cabeza atrás y {sfx:song} cantó su canción más alegre, batiendo las alas. {squirrel:hearts} {canvas:night 0.6 16s} [softly] Esa noche, se acurrucó en su nido, redondo y calentito, {bird:face sleeping} y soñó con sus amigos.

tap.prompt: a woodpecker tapping three light knocks on tree bark

song.prompt: a small bright songbird singing a short, happy, trilling song
